scope: Temporary build-only Go runtime backport; no installed Go tree changes, trust-policy changes, public release or push.
upstreamStatus: Open and unmerged at inspection; this is not an official Go release fix.

controlledReproducer.condition: A syscall goroutine temporarily holds its scan bit during the initial stop-the-world sweep. The original wait loop cannot retake its P and waits for sysmon. A pending one-second timer bounds the original failure.
controlledReproducer.interpretation: This proves the runtime defect and its correction in the controlled Windows reproducer. It does not prove that this exact scan-bit race caused every Krasis recovery incident.

implementation.upstreamAdaptation: Omit a context-only preemptall line absent from Go 1.27.3; add duration logging to the regression fixture.
implementation.integrity: Check the exact toolchain, canonical original source SHA-256, patched source SHA-256, unique hunk contexts and existing overlay cache contents. Unknown compiler versions require revalidation instead of silently dropping the backport.
implementation.securityPolicy: Existing five-second trust freshness, fail-closed behavior, GC configuration and processor count are unchanged.
implementation.maintenance: Revalidate this temporary backport when updating Go; remove it after an official stable runtime fix passes the same reproducer.
implementation.rollback: Revert the build integration and create a newer generation using stock Go; do not overwrite running generations or bypass installer generation checks.

additionalIncident.limitation: The later protected-input failure is a separate observed failure; its causality is not established by this runtime reproduction.

runtimeRegressionSkipped.TestSyscallN: GCC is unavailable; the upstream test skipped.

validation.syntaxAndWhitespace: Node syntax checks and git diff --check passed.
validation.physicalCrossingAcceptance: Pending new-generation installation and user physical input; no claim of a resolved field incident.
